label: Fair
corporate_parent: AHF Products (formerly Armstrong Flooring). Brands: Bruce, Armstrong, Hartco. Post-bankruptcy reorganization.
manufacturing_location: AHF Products US facilities — confirm specific plant for Hydropel

veneer_specification.refinishing_cycles: ZERO — not refinishable. Replace when worn. 1.2mm rotary-peeled veneer cannot be sanded.
veneer_specification.description: 1.2mm rotary-peeled veneer is below the refinishing threshold. This is functionally a 'real wood laminate' — hardwood face on engineered substrate, but not a floor you maintain for decades. Rotary-peeled grain pattern looks manufactured, not natural.

core_construction.description: HDF (high-density fiberboard) core — uniform for click-lock floating floor. More moisture-vulnerable than plywood. Thin total construction.

finish_system.description: Standard UV-cured urethane finish — not aluminum oxide enhanced.

water_resistance.description: Hydropel water-resistant technology — edge and surface treatment. Similar concept to Shaw Repel. Provides some protection against spills.

milling_precision.description: Click-lock system — more consistent than tongue-and-groove for thin products. DIY-friendly installation.

performance_evidence.dimensional_stability: Good — HDF core is dimensionally stable but moisture-vulnerable.
performance_evidence.refinishing_potential: NOT REFINISHABLE — this is the key performance limitation. 1.2mm rotary veneer cannot be sanded. When the finish wears through, the floor must be replaced.
performance_evidence.moisture_resistance: Enhanced — Hydropel technology provides some water resistance. Better than standard engineered but not waterproof.
performance_evidence.installation_versatility: All methods — click-lock floating is primary. DIY-friendly over any flat subfloor.

delamination_risk.notes: HDF core with thin veneer — delamination possible under moisture stress

formaldehyde.notes: HDF core uses adhesives — formaldehyde compliance critical. CARB Phase 2 certified.

durability_evidence.warranty_claim_process: Standard manufacturer — AHF Products post-bankruptcy uncertainty applies
durability_evidence.lifespan_expectation: 10-15 years in residential use — not a lifetime floor due to non-refinishable veneer

safety_evidence.formaldehyde: CARB Phase 2 compliant — HDF core adhesive formaldehyde content is the key safety spec. Compliance confirmed but Greenguard Gold status needs verification.
safety_evidence.notes: HDF core engineered products have inherently higher formaldehyde risk than solid hardwood or plywood-core engineered. Compliance is mandatory but worth monitoring.

platform_disclosure.cross_brand: Bruce/Armstrong/Hartco share AHF Products manufacturing platform. Report must disclose.
platform_disclosure.quality_cliff_note: This product represents the quality cliff in engineered hardwood. Below 2mm rotary-peeled veneer, the product is functionally a 'real wood laminate' — hardwood surface appearance but without the longevity or refinishing capability that defines hardwood flooring.
